new_today_news.headline: BPCL, Akasa Air join hands to boost Sustainable Aviation Fuel adoption in India
new_today_news.summary: BPCL and Akasa Air signed an MoU to collaborate on sustainable aviation fuel development in India. BPCL is investing in a 61 KTPA SAF production facility at its Mumbai Refinery, with fuel to be produced from renewable feedstocks including used cooking oil.
